message.content:
The interior angle of a regular heptagon is

\[
\frac{(7-2)\cdot 180^\circ}{7}=\frac{900^\circ}{7}.
\]

So

\[
\angle BAD=\frac{900^\circ}{7}.
\]

Since \(AC\) is a side of the square sharing side \(AD\), we have

\[
\angle CAD=90^\circ.
\]

Thus

\[
\angle BAC=\angle BAD-\angle CAD
=\frac{900^\circ}{7}-90^\circ
=\frac{900^\circ-630^\circ}{7}
=\frac{270^\circ}{7}.
\]

The answer is \(\frac{270}{7}\).
